verdict.rationale: Parahelp documents an API for running the Customer Agent and Internal Agent, so the axis applies. No evidence shows API versioning or a deprecation policy. The 'versioned' releases and knowledge version history cover configuration and content changes, which is an adjacent feature, not API versioning. OpenAPI spec probes also returned 404.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can rely on versioned APIs with a documented deprecation policy
